result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations: the partial-fraction expansion of $1/(x^n-1)^2$ applied to lattice sums of the form $\sum 1/((x-m)^n+y^n)^2$, a Taylor-expansion step, a Fourier-type integral representation of a three-dimensional lattice sum via exponentials, and a saddle-point (stationary exponent) evaluation of $\int e^{-sx^n+tx}dx$.
result.transcription:
$y=\frac{\alpha a+\beta b}{\gamma a+\delta b}$
$\frac{1}{(x^n-1)^2}=\frac{1}{n}\sum\frac{\alpha}{(x-\alpha)^2}-\frac{1}{2}\frac{n-1}{x-\alpha}$
$\sum\frac{1}{((x-m)^n+y^n)^2}=\frac{1}{y^{2n}}\frac{1}{n}\sum\frac{\alpha}{(\frac{x-m}{y}-\alpha)^2}-\frac{1}{2}\frac{n-1}{(\frac{x-m}{y}-\alpha)}$
$x^n-1=\alpha^n-1[-+n\alpha^{n-1}-]+n\alpha^{n-1}(x-\alpha)+n\frac{n-1}{1\cdot2}\alpha^{n-2}(x-\alpha)^2+[-\dots-]$
$f(x)=f(\alpha)+(x-\alpha)f'(\alpha)+\frac{f''(\alpha)}{2}(x-\alpha)^2+\dots$
$f'\alpha+\frac{f''\alpha}{2}(x-\alpha)+\frac{f'''\alpha}{6}(x-\alpha)^2$
$\frac{1}{f'\alpha}\left(1-\frac{f''(\alpha)}{2f'(\alpha)}[-(x-\alpha)-]\right)$ $n\alpha^{n-1}$
$\frac{1}{f'\alpha}\left(1-\frac{1}{2}(x-\alpha)\frac{\partial\log f'(\alpha)}{\partial\alpha}\right)$
$\frac{1}{n\alpha^{n-1}}\left(1-\frac{1}{2}(x-\alpha)\frac{n-1}{\alpha}\right)$
$\sum\frac{1}{((x-a)^n+(y-b)^n-(z-c)^n)^2}=\sum[-\cdot-]\cos 2\pi\alpha x\cos 2\pi\beta y\cos 2\pi\gamma z$
$\frac{1}{(2\pi)^3}\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{1}{(x^n+y^n-z^n)^2}e^{\alpha 2\pi xi+\beta 2\pi yi+\gamma 2\pi zi}\partial x\,\partial y\,\partial z$
$\int_0^\infty\int_{-\infty}^\infty\int_{-\infty}^\infty\int_{-\infty}^\infty e^{-s(x^n+y^n-z^n)+\alpha 2\pi xi+\dots}\,s\,\partial s\,\partial x\,\partial y\,\partial z$

$\int e^{-sx^n+tx}\partial x$
$-nsx^{n-1}+t=0$
$x=\left(\frac{t}{ns}\right)^{\frac{1}{n-1}}$
$e^{-\frac{t}{n}\left(\frac{t}{ns}\right)^{\frac{1}{n-1}}+t\left(\frac{t}{ns}\right)^{\frac{1}{n-1}}}$
$e^{\left(1-\frac{1}{n}\right)t^{\frac{n}{n-1}}(sn)^{-\frac{1}{n-1}}}$

$\int_0^\infty e^{-s}[?]\,\partial s=1$

methods.what: Partial fraction expansion of 1/(x^n-1)^2 over the n-th roots of unity
Application of that expansion to the sum over m of 1/((x-m)^n+y^n)^2
Taylor expansion about a root to obtain the coefficients of the double pole
Fourier series of a 3D lattice sum with coefficients given by Fourier integrals
